verdicts.reason: A rewraps the headline sensibly for the tall format and keeps a clean centred stack, but parks it in the top third and leaves a huge dead middle above the circle. B drops the text block to the bottom, so the tagline sits almost on top of the circle; the area is cramped while the top half is empty.

A is basically a shrunk copy of the square: it keeps the awkward 'Sip / at sunset.' break, the headline is small, and the brand tagline is shrunk to an illegible ~5px. B rewraps to 'Sparkle slowly. / Sip at sunset.' at a readable size with a legible tagline, though the empty middle makes it top-heavy.

In A the headline nearly runs edge to edge and the block is pushed down, so the tagline almost touches the circle; it is crowded at the bottom and the top half is empty. B has the same near-edge headline margins and a dead middle, but its text block is clear of the circle and reads top-down.

A has a top-anchored centred stack with slightly wider side margins than the others and a readable tagline, but it is still lopsided with dead space in the middle. B puts the wide headline low with the tagline jammed just above the circle, which creates a near-collision and leaves the whole upper canvas empty.
